gloss: to be shrewd; to slyly take advantage

definitions.gloss: to be shrewd; to be calculating; to slyly take advantage; to look out for oneself
definitions.explanation: To cleverly and often shamelessly take advantage of a situation for one's own benefit. Implies a mix of shrewdness and cheekiness — the person manages to come out ahead while others might not notice or can only shake their heads.

examples.japanese: ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: They slyly grabbed the best seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ちゃっかりして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is shrewd, so she always comes out ahead.

examples.japanese: {皆|みんな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{片付|かたづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: While everyone was cleaning up, they shrewdly slipped away and went home first.

notes:
An onomatopoeic/mimetic expression describing someone who is cleverly self-serving. Often used with a tone of mild exasperation or amused admiration. Not as strongly negative as "selfish" — it implies being impressively cheeky.

USAGE:
Most commonly used as the adverb ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧ modifying a verb (⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧). The ちゃっかりして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form describes someone who has this personality trait.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: a shrewd person; someone who always looks out for themselves
- ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: same as above, slightly more colloquial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちゃっかり→ちゃっかり：06277_chakkari⟧: the adverbial form — more common than the ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}がない→抜け目がない：28319_nukemeganai⟧: shrewd; never misses a trick — similar meaning but without the playful tone
- ずるい: sly; cunning — more negative; implies unfairness
- ⟦{要領|ようりょう}がいい→要領がいい：19930_youryougaii⟧: to be good at getting things done efficiently — more positive framing of a similar skill

REGISTER:
Casual and colloquial. Used in everyday conversation, often with humor.
